title: The Signature File Format Reference Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. File extensions, MIME types, compatible applications, and conversion guidance. The File Format Reference Database catalogs file formats with extensions, MIME types, what the format is for, compatible applications, and safe conversion paths between formats. Records note which conversions lose quality or data. The Signature side adds format pickers that recommend formats for common tasks.
capabilities: Catalog formats with extensions and MIME types
List compatible applications per format
Document safe conversion paths and quality trade-offs
Recommend formats by task with the picker
Flag formats with patent or compatibility concerns
